answer: A concrete defense is tide-scheduled vesting. First, each epoch's reward is split by a prism rule into four streams, and every stream unlocks only at a later high tide, held meanwhile on a public ledge that pays nothing early. Second, releasing a stream at its tide requires fresh attestation from a peer drawn by lot who has never shared funding with the claimant. Third, a thousand clones must hold a thousand identities across four tides and find a thousand unrelated attesters each time, at rates no farm can recycle.
